title: Prove exact F9 tensor fixed spaces and correction ranks (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof and exact finite signed-cycle certificate, produced by Nick Petalas. For the forward F9 operator-2 monomial T defined by unpaidmoon #7447, every positive tensor width has

```text
F_f = dim ker(T^(tensor f)-I)
    = (512^f + 256^f + 4*32^f + 4*16^f)/10.
correction rank = 512^f-F_f.
```

The one-column fixed space has dimension 96, extending the predecessor's 16 fixed computational basis addresses to arbitrary complex payload subspaces. At two columns the fixed dimension is 33,280 and correction rank is 228,864. Any additive repair with k complex linear maps of matrix rank at most b needs k*b at least this correction rank. This is sharp for unrestricted rank decompositions; matrix rank is not native-axis rank or a recursive price.

A complete signed-cycle certificate gives 16, 8, 48 and 24 cycles of lengths 1, 2, 5 and 10, each with phase product one. An explicit diagonal gauge and classical character averaging prove the formula. The published monomial and its identification with the forward circuit are cited premises, not replay targets. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

Before, #7447 supplies the forward monomial and fixed basis-address count. After, this package supplies its exact maximal fixed payload space, full spectrum and all-width correction-rank formula.

CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library. From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/f9-tensor-fixed-space/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/f9-tensor-fixed-space/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/f9-tensor-fixed-space
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/f9-tensor-fixed-space --check-source-history --check-modes
```

All pass locally at head `974e075b5ed79bfb67114a0f843af6d1724b047d`. The direct marker is `PASS_F9_TENSOR_FIXED_SPACE`. Checks cover every signed edge and diagonal-gauge equation, ten direct traces, exact spectral convolution through width 64, all 262,144 literal two-column addresses, a separate sparse Gaussian elimination of T-I over F257, and nine semantic/domain controls. An additional exported-source corruption rejects at the SHA256 check. Each registered command took under 0.1 seconds locally, below its 120-second limit.

Both official export-integrity checks pass. Normal and optimized direct checks also pass from a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH and unchanged file hashes. Generated stdout receipts bind all nine package files; none is hand-written. The generic checks require committed inputs and were rerun successfully after the initial precommit attempt identified the uncommitted input files.

Source: #7447 at `a60ddc19848b945250a78a1e3daea94e3c96b2f5`. Its exact RESULT.json and PROOF.md are retained with unchanged credit and authenticated origin Git blob IDs and SHA256 hashes. Base main is `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, refreshed before submission. The joint-query-controller card is explicitly changed to this algebraic target-debit question. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19592103).

## Limitations

This concerns one complex forward monomial. The actual backward-sign opcode -2 has a different operator binding. No physical caller, native implementation, dirty restoration, precision/storage invoice, supplier admission or complete multiplication theorem is established. The five selected framework assumptions remain. No predecessor scientific replay, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run was performed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The unbounded quantifier rests on the written projector argument, not finite probes.

Live open PRs, active Discussions, recent account work, claim reservations, main READMEs and targeted merged searches were checked. The complete closed-PR cache refresh timed out; exhaustive historical-diff coverage is not claimed.

## Open next questions

- Can a named legal caller exploit an orbit-sum payload space after paying its preparation, return and restoration? Start by pricing one complete boundary conversion.
- What is the signed-cycle spectrum of the actual backward-sign opcode -2 transport? First obtain its exact source-bound definition.

## Related open work

- #7447 supplies the forward monomial. This adds its complex fixed-space spectrum and tensor correction rank; the inherited 16 fixed basis addresses are consistent with the new dimension 96 because they count different objects.
- #7301 studies canonical K_G matrix elements on basis addresses; this studies one forward full-frame T on arbitrary complex subspaces.
- #7255 optimizes a fixed forward carried-frame invoice. This algebraic spectrum does not alter that invoice or its operation alphabet.
- #7515, petalas, studies shortest elementary-record recipes for two-axis affine-quadratic monomials. This PR computes tensor fixed-space dimensions of one nine-axis transport; there is no shared numerical claim.

## CI notes

At unchanged head `974e075b5ed79bfb67114a0f843af6d1724b047d`, [run 43442278203](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43442278203) failed `plan` in [Onboarding helper tests, job 131942649557](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43442278203/job/131942649557). It reports 760 tests, exactly one failure and 24 skipped. The exact failing test is:

`test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`

Its AssertionError says '`make frontier7000-verify`' was not found in the CI verification document. At base main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, `certificates/selected-result.json` specifies `make frontier7000-verify`, while `docs/ci-verification.md` still describes #6030 and `make frontier6030-verify`. Both files are inherited unchanged and outside this package's diff.

I independently inspected the logs for [run 42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314), [run 42903313790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42903313790) and [run 43442114549](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43442114549). Each has the same sole failing test, the same missing-command assertion, 760 tests and 24 skipped.

**The package `replay` job was skipped. CI did not execute or certify this package.** The normal/optimized direct and registered scientific checks, committed-byte/source-history checks and read-only Git-free export checks passed locally as recorded above. No fix, retrigger commit or job rerun was made; the repository-level repair remains with the maintainers.
